identity.name: Overseas Self-Winding

case.bezel: six-sided, derived from the Maltese cross

identity.one_liner: The current-generation 41mm Overseas — a quiet case-and-bracelet refinement of the 4500V, same caliber 5100.

narrative.story: Rather than reinvent a working formula, Vacheron rolled the 4520V out quietly from late 2023: same 41mm footprint and caliber 5100 as the 4500V, with reworked case and bracelet details and the interchangeable strap system carried over. No launch spectacle — boutiques simply began delivering the new reference. It is the Overseas you buy new today.
narrative.collector_notes: Transitional years mean 4500V and 4520V examples sit side by side on the secondary market at similar money — check which reference is actually on the papers. All three wearing options should be in the box, as with the 4500V.
